goal: Compare original v1.2.2 and one predetermined candidate for each of day/pre09/long. Do not tune thresholds to evaluation results. If results fail, keep observations but disable validated-buy status.
entry: First scheduled 5-minute candle open at decision+5min; never same candle high/low or hypothetical cheaper limit price.
long_decision: 09:00 KST, next day open entry to allow response/decision latency
universe: Diagnostic KRW universe and available candles. Short uses recorded lifecycle/warnings and top30 trailing-hour liquidity; long uses retrievable historical candle existence. Pre-08:50 pool liquidity approximated from completed hourly candles. Not complete historical orderbook or full tick replay.
selection: Compare strict pass top5, observation top5, and liquid-universe equal-weight/BTC/cash. No outcome-based top5 substitutions. Equal timestamp weighting and equal day weighting reported.
candidate_day: Positive completed-hour trend and BTC relative momentum; completed5m 15min acceleration; ATR-normalized relative strength rank; avoid overextension; current observed close and costs for support/resistance room.
candidate_pre09: Independent 5m squeeze/volume acceleration and close-position rule with hourly relative strength; entry only08:30-08:55, validity2min and noentryafter08:58. Not a subset of day buy qualification.
candidate_long: Positive20/60/120day trend and BTC regime; positive30/90day relative momentum; volatility-normalized momentum rank; require positive cost-adjusted resistance room at observed price.
validation_gate: Requires >=30 evaluation observations across >=10 short signal days or >=90 long signal days; base and stress net positive; paired advantage over liquid benchmark positive; day/block-bootstrap lower95% mean net >0. Long block=90days; short cluster=day. Must disclose universe/quote approximations; never claim prospective or real-account validation.
previously_seen: Earlier reports already examined some 2026 outcomes. These are retrospective date-separated evaluations, not a pristine prospective holdout.
